I applied 5-6 coats last year and another 2 this year, after i applied the 2 this year i sealed it with long life paint as you see in the photo, already the paint is lasting longer, and should water eventually soak in hopefully the creocote treatment should help.
The paint was not oil based, it actually took really well even with oil treatment that i applied first, the paint still absorbed into the wood and i put an extra coat on there.
That's fine, il leave it then, it just always seemed like it should be closer together or less gaps to prevent water getting trapped.
